name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie flat on the bench with feet planted and eyes under the bar.
Grip slightly wider than shoulder width and unrack the bar.
Lower the bar to mid-chest with elbows about 45 degrees.
Press back up until arms are extended without locking out hard.
common_mistakes: Bouncing the bar off the chest
safety_notes: Use a spotter or safety pins when training near failure.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Set the bench to about 30 degrees.
Press dumbbells up from shoulder level until arms are extended.
Lower under control until you feel a stretch across the upper chest.
common_mistakes: Clashing the dumbbells at the top

name: Push-Up
instructions: Start in a plank with hands slightly wider than shoulders.
Keep a straight line from head to heels and brace your core.
Lower until your chest is just above the floor, then press back up.

name: Cable Chest Fly
instructions: Set cables to chest height and take a staggered stance.
With a slight elbow bend, bring the handles together in front of you.
Control the return until you feel a stretch across the chest.
common_mistakes: Using too much weight and losing the stretch

name: Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from a bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulders.
Pull your chest toward the bar by driving elbows down.
Lower under control to a full hang.
common_mistakes: Not reaching full extension at the bottom

name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Grip the bar wider than shoulder width and sit with thighs secured.
Pull the bar to your upper chest, leading with the elbows.
Control the bar back up to a full stretch.

name: Bent-Over Barbell Row
instructions: Hinge at the hips with a flat back and soft knees.
Row the bar to your lower ribs, squeezing the shoulder blades.
Lower under control without rounding the back.
common_mistakes: Using momentum to heave the weight
safety_notes: Keep the load moderate to protect a neutral spine.

name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sit tall with a slight lean and grab the handle.
Pull to your stomach, driving the elbows back.
Return under control to a full stretch.

name: Overhead Press
instructions: Hold the bar at shoulder height with hands just outside shoulders.
Brace your core and press overhead, moving your head back then through.
Lock out overhead, then lower under control.
common_mistakes: Pressing the bar around the face
safety_notes: Brace hard and avoid leaning back to protect the lower back.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand with dumbbells at your sides, elbows slightly bent.
Raise the weights out to the sides to about shoulder height.
Lower slowly under control.

name: Face Pull
instructions: Set a rope at upper-chest height.
Pull the rope toward your face, splitting it apart as you go.
Control the return.

name: Barbell Biceps Curl
instructions: Hold the bar with an underhand shoulder-width grip.
Curl the bar up by flexing the elbows, keeping them at your sides.
Lower under control to full extension.

name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
instructions: Hold dumbbells with a neutral (palms-facing) grip.
Curl up while keeping the wrists neutral.
Lower under control.

name: Triceps Rope Pushdown
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley and grab it with a neutral grip.
Keep elbows pinned and extend down, spreading the rope at the bottom.
Control the return to about 90 degrees.

name: Overhead Dumbbell Triceps Extension
instructions: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands.
Lower behind your head by bending the elbows.
Extend back overhead under control.

name: Barbell Back Squat
instructions: Set the bar on your upper back and stand with feet shoulder-width.
Brace, then sit down and back until thighs are at least parallel.
Drive up through mid-foot to standing.
safety_notes: Squat inside a rack with safety pins set below depth.

name: Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell at chest height.
Squat down keeping your torso upright and elbows inside the knees.
Drive back up to standing.

name: Leg Press
instructions: Sit in the machine with feet shoulder-width on the platform.
Lower the platform until knees reach about 90 degrees.
Press back without locking the knees hard.
common_mistakes: Letting the lower back round at the bottom
safety_notes: Do not let the knees collapse inward under load.

name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hold the bar at your thighs with a flat back.
Push the hips back, lowering the bar along your legs until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Drive the hips forward to stand tall.
common_mistakes: Bar drifting away from the legs
safety_notes: Keep the bar close and stop when the back would otherwise round.

name: Lying Leg Curl
instructions: Lie face down with the pad above your heels.
Curl your heels toward your glutes.
Lower under control.

name: Conventional Deadlift
instructions: Set up with the bar over mid-foot and shins close.
Grip the bar, brace, and take the slack out.
Drive the floor away and stand tall, then lower with control.
common_mistakes: Jerking the bar off the floor
safety_notes: Prioritize a braced, neutral spine over load.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit with your upper back against a bench and the bar over your hips.
Drive through your heels to lift the hips until the torso is parallel to the floor.
Squeeze the glutes at the top, then lower under control.
safety_notes: Use a pad and avoid hyperextending at the top.

name: Walking Lunge
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides.
Step forward and lower until both knees are about 90 degrees.
Drive through the front heel and step into the next lunge.

name: Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Stand with the balls of your feet on a raised surface.
Rise onto your toes as high as possible.
Lower slowly for a full stretch.

name: Plank
instructions: Rest on your forearms and toes with a straight body line.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Hold for the target time without sagging.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
instructions: Hang from a bar with a controlled grip.
Raise your legs to about hip height or higher, keeping them straight.
Lower under control without swinging.

name: Cable Crunch
instructions: Kneel below a rope attachment and hold it by your head.
Crunch down by flexing the spine, bringing elbows toward the thighs.
Return under control.
common_mistakes: Hinging at the hips instead of crunching

name: Treadmill Run
instructions: Set a comfortable pace and incline.
Maintain an upright posture and relaxed arms.
Keep to your target duration or distance.

name: Jump Rope
instructions: Turn the rope with your wrists, not your arms.
Jump just high enough to clear the rope.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.

name: Burpee
instructions: From standing, drop into a squat and place your hands down.
Kick your feet back to a plank and perform a push-up.
Return your feet and jump up explosively.

name: Mountain Climber
instructions: Start in a strong plank position.
Drive one knee toward your chest, then switch quickly.
Keep your hips low and core braced throughout.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit or stand with dumbbells at shoulder height.
Press overhead until arms are extended.
Lower under control to the starting position.
common_mistakes: Pressing the weights forward instead of up

name: Chin-Up
instructions: Hang from a bar with an underhand shoulder-width grip.
Pull until your chin clears the bar.
Lower under control to a full hang.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hold dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Hinge at the hips, lowering the weights along your legs.
Drive the hips forward to stand tall.
safety_notes: Stop the descent before the lower back rounds.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Rest your rear foot on a bench behind you.
Lower straight down until the front thigh is about parallel.
Drive through the front heel to stand.

name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Drive through your heels to lift the hips.
Squeeze the glutes at the top, then lower.

name: Machine Chest Press
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles are at mid-chest.
Press the handles forward until arms are extended.
Return under control to a stretch.
common_mistakes: Setting the seat too high or low

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
instructions: Brace one hand and knee on a bench with a flat back.
Row the dumbbell to your hip, leading with the elbow.
Lower under control to a full stretch.
